grammar_focus: used to do 表过去的习惯/状态(现已停止、不再重复:used to work / used to be)· 与一般过去时(一次性动作)、过去进行时(当时正在做)对比(主考)+ which 引导定语从句(指物)/ when 引导时间状语从句(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 昨天下午弗兰克·霍金斯向'我'讲他年轻时的经历。退休前他是一家大公司的负责人,但小时候他曾在一家小店做工,专修自行车,一天要干14个小时。他积蓄多年,1958年买下自己的一间小车间;二十几岁时给飞机做零配件,雇了两个帮手。几年后小车间变成了一家雇有728人的大工厂。他回想早年的艰辛,微笑着——正笑着,门开了,妻子进来要他去修孙子的自行车!

grammar_card.title: used to do:过去的习惯与状态
grammar_card.intro: used to + 动词原形,表示过去经常做、或过去的状态,而现在已经停止、不再这样。跟'一次性动作(一般过去时)'和'当时正在做(过去进行时)'不同。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: He used to work fourteen hours a day.
He used to be a mailman. He's a taxi driver now.
He didn't use to smoke. Did you use to collect stamps?
对比:一次性动作 → 一般过去
对比:当时正在做 → 过去进行
When I was watering the garden, it began to rain.

specialRules.rule: which 引导定语从句指物:a factory which employed 728 people 一家雇了728人的工厂
when 引导时间状语从句'当…时':He was still smiling when the door opened.

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What was Frank's first job?
options: He used to repair bicycles in a small store
He made airplanes in a factory

passage: Yesterday afternoon Frank Hawkins was telling me about his experiences as a young man. Before he retired, Frank was the head of a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small store. It was his job to repair bicycles, and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day. He saved money for years, and in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own. In his twenties, Frank used to make spare parts for airplanes. At that time he had two helpers. In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people. Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success. He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in. She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
